title: Lead Designer
description:
Job Summary

We're looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Photo Retoucher & Creative Studio Associate to support our visual content and studio operations. In this role, you'll help bring our jewellery collections to life through high-quality image editing, retouching, and creative asset management.

Working closely with photographers, designers, and marketing teams, you'll contribute to creating premium visual experiences that reflect the craftsmanship and elegance behind every piece.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • A strong eye for detail and visual excellence.
  • Passion for creating polished, premium-quality creative outputs.
  • A willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced creative environment.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to work across teams.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and urgent creative requirements.
  • Commitment to maintaining consistency and quality across every deliverable.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Degree or Diploma in Design, Multimedia, Visual Communication, or a related field.

Experience

  • 0–2 years of experience in photo editing, jewellery retouching, studio support, or related creative roles.
  • Freshers with strong portfolios and a keen eye for detail are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience in jewellery, retail, e-commerce, creative studios, or agencies is an added advantage.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Understanding of image editing, colour correction, masking, and file management.
  • Familiarity with jewellery photography and retouching workflows is preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of metal polishing, gemstone enhancement, and premium product retouching techniques.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong eye for detail and visual excellence.
  • Passion for creating polished, premium-quality creative outputs.
  • A willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced creative environment.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to work across teams.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and urgent creative requirements.
  • Commitment to maintaining consistency and quality across every deliverable.

Why Join Us?

At Sunny Diamonds, every image tells a story of craftsmanship, precision, and timeless beauty. As part of our creative team, you'll work closely with experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful brand experiences, and develop specialised skills in luxury jewellery content creation.

If you're passionate about design, visual storytelling, and creating exceptional work, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Retail Sales Manager
summary: Lead our showroom sales team and create thoughtful, memorable experiences for every guest.
description:
Job Summary

The Retail Sales Manager at Sunny Diamonds is responsible for leading the showroom sales team, optimizing daily store operations, and driving store profitability. This leadership role ensures the delivery of a premium, personalized customer experience while securely managing high-value diamond inventory. The manager will inspire and guide the team to meet and exceed sales targets, build lasting client relationships, and uphold the prestigious standards of the Sunny Diamonds brand.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead, train, and motivate the showroom sales team to consistently achieve and exceed daily, monthly, and annual revenue targets.
  • Oversee comprehensive daily showroom operations, ensuring a flawless, secure, and welcoming luxury environment for all clients.
  • Develop and execute effective sales strategies and on-floor promotional activities in alignment with broader business objectives.
  • Manage high-value diamond inventory, overseeing regular stock audits, replenishment, visual merchandising, and strict loss prevention procedures.
  • Act as the highest point of escalation on the sales floor, handling VIP clients and resolving complex customer concerns with grace and professionalism.
  • Analyze sales data, footfall, and consumer trends to provide actionable insights and comprehensive reports to senior management.
  • Ensure strict adherence to organizational processes, pricing policies, and stringent security standards.
  • Manage staff schedules, conduct regular performance reviews, and identify ongoing training opportunities for team development.
  • Collaborate with the marketing and merchandising teams to ensure optimal product placement and alignment with brand campaigns.
  • Perform any additional operational and managerial responsibilities as required by the business.

Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Certifications in retail management or business leadership are an added advantage.

Experience

  • 5+ years of proven experience in retail management, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.
  • Demonstrated success in managing a team, driving sales growth, and operating in the luxury goods, hospitality, or fine jewellery sector.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with modern retail Point of Sale (POS) systems, CRM software, and inventory management platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in reporting tools (Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets) for analyzing sales data.
  • Understanding of luxury retail best practices and visual merchandising standards.

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional leadership, mentoring, and team-building skills.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication abilities.
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to remain calm, decisive, and adaptable in a fast-paced retail environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience managing a fine jewellery or diamond boutique.
  • Professional certifications from recognized gemological institutes (e.g., GIA, IGI).
  • An established network or experience in high-net-worth client relationship management.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and business acumen
  • Team leadership and mentorship
  • Customer-centric mindset with a focus on luxury clienteling
  • Ownership, accountability, and results-driven focus
  • Conflict resolution and decisive critical thinking
  • Attention to detail regarding inventory and store presentation

Working Conditions

  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Work Location: Sunny Diamonds Showroom (Specific Location)
  • Work Mode: On-site
  • Working Hours: Retail management hours (requires flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and during special promotional events)

Reporting Structure

  • Reports To: Regional Retail Manager / Head of Sales
  • Direct Reports: Junior Sales Advisors, Senior Sales Advisors, Customer Experience Executives

Success Metrics

  • Achievement of overall showroom revenue, conversion rates, and profitability targets.
  • High customer satisfaction scores and increased repeat clientele volume.
  • Impeccable inventory control with zero shrinkage and full compliance with security protocols.
  • High team morale, low staff turnover, and successful internal progression of sales advisors.

title: Junior Jewellery Sales Advisor
summary: Guide clients through our collections with care, curiosity and strong product knowledge.
description:
Job Summary Sunny diamonds

The Junior Jewellery Sales Advisor serves as the first point of contact for clients at Sunny Diamonds, delivering an exceptional luxury retail experience. The primary purpose of this role is to assist customers in selecting the perfect diamond jewellery, educating them on diamond quality (the 4Cs), and driving store revenue. This position plays a crucial role in building lasting customer relationships and upholding the Sunny Diamonds standard of excellence, directly contributing to the brand's reputation and financial goals.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Greet and assist customers in the showroom, providing a welcoming and luxurious shopping experience.
  • Collaborate with store management, inventory, and customer service teams to ensure seamless store operations and customer satisfaction.
  • Ensure strict adherence to organizational security processes, pricing policies, and quality standards for handling high-value diamond inventory.
  • Analyze customer requirements, budget, and preferences to provide personalized and effective jewellery recommendations.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate sales documentation, process invoices, and update customer profiles in the CRM system.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements in visual merchandising and daily showroom operations.
  • Communicate customer feedback, sales trends, and inventory issues to the Store Manager in a timely manner.
  • Stay updated with industry trends, diamond grading standards (the 4Cs), and the details of Sunny Diamonds' latest collections.
  • Support team members with daily floor duties, including opening/closing procedures and maintaining pristine display cases.
  • Perform any additional showroom responsibilities assigned by management.

Qualifications and Experience

Education

  1. Bachelor's degree in Business, Retail Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  2. Basic certifications in gemology or retail sales are an added advantage.

Experience

1 to 2 years of professional experience in luxury retail, customer service, or high-end hospitality.

  • Demonstrated ability to successfully hit sales targets and build client relationships in a similar customer-facing role.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in using Point of Sale (POS) systems and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software.
  • Strong understanding of luxury retail best practices and basic visual merchandising.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication, active listening, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to handle customer concerns gracefully.
  • Ability to work independently on the sales floor and collaboratively as part of the showroom team.
  • Good organizational and time management skills, especially during peak retail hours.
  • Adaptability, a positive attitude, and a strong willingness to learn about diamond quality and craftsmanship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in the fine jewellery industry or luxury goods domain.
  • Additional certifications from recognized gemological institutes (e.g., GIA, IGI).
  • Fluency in multiple languages to assist a diverse clientele.

Key Competencies

  • Ownership and accountability in driving personal sales goals.
  • Teamwork and collaboration on the showroom floor.
  • Customer-centric mindset with a passion for delivering memorable experiences.
  • Exceptional attention to detail when handling and presenting diamond jewellery.
  • Continuous learning regarding product knowledge and sales techniques.
  • Decision-making and critical thinking in navigating customer objections.

Working Conditions

  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Work Location: Sunny Diamonds Showroom (Specific Location)
  • Work Mode: On-site
  • Working Hours: Standard retail hours (includes weekends, holidays, and promotional events as required)

Reporting Structure

  • Reports To: Showroom Manager / Store Manager
  • Direct Reports: None (Individual Contributor)

Success Metrics

  • Achievement of individual monthly and quarterly sales KPIs.
  • Quality and accuracy of daily inventory handling and sales reporting.
  • High stakeholder and customer satisfaction (measured by customer feedback and repeat clientele).
  • Strict compliance with Sunny Diamonds' operational standards, security protocols, and grooming guidelines.

title: Senior Finance Professional
summary: Strengthen financial planning, reporting and controls across our growing jewellery business.
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Finance Professional at Sunny Diamonds plays a pivotal role in driving the financial health and strategic growth of the organization. This role is responsible for overseeing complex financial operations, including financial planning and analysis (FP&A), budgeting, forecasting, and rigorous inventory valuation. Serving as a strategic partner to the executive team, this position ensures robust financial controls, regulatory compliance, and optimized cash flow to support the brand's expansion in the luxury diamond and fine jewellery market.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead the comprehensive financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes for the organization.
  • Oversee daily financial operations, including cash flow management, working capital optimization, and accounts payable/receivable.
  • Ensure accurate and timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and performance reports.
  • Manage the financial aspects of high-value inventory, including accurate valuation of diamonds, precious metals, and finished goods.
  • Monitor and ensure strict adherence to all statutory compliances, tax regulations, and internal financial policies.
  • Coordinate with external and internal auditors to facilitate smooth financial audits and implement audit recommendations.
  • Analyze financial data to identify cost-saving opportunities, operational inefficiencies, and areas for revenue growth.
  • Provide strategic financial insights and risk assessments to senior management for new store openings, marketing campaigns, and capital investments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Retail, Supply Chain, and Marketing, to align financial goals with business operations.
  • Mentor and guide junior finance team members, fostering a culture of accuracy, integrity, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration (MBA Finance), or equivalent.
  • Professional accounting qualification such as Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, CMA, or ACCA is highly required.

Experience

  • 7 to 10+ years of progressive experience in corporate finance, financial planning, or accounting.
  • Demonstrated track record of successfully managing finances in the retail, luxury goods, or manufacturing sectors.

Technical Skills

  • Expert proficiency in financial modeling, data analysis, and advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • Hands-on experience with modern ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics) and business intelligence tools.
  • In-depth understanding of local taxation laws, corporate finance principles, and accounting standards (Ind AS / IFRS).

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex financial data to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • High level of integrity, ethical standards, and a strict commitment to confidentiality.
  • Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and adapt to a dynamic business environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience working within the gems and jewellery industry, specifically handling precious stone and metal accounting.
  • Experience dealing with international trade finance, customs duties, and import/export compliance.
  • Proven experience leading financial software migrations or ERP implementations.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic financial vision and business acumen
  • Ownership, accountability, and ethical integrity
  • Attention to detail and precision in reporting
  • Stakeholder management and cross-departmental collaboration
  • Risk management and compliance focus
  • Continuous learning and adaptability to market changes

Working Conditions

  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Work Location: Sunny Diamonds Corporate Office
  • Work Mode: On-site / Hybrid (as per company policy)
  • Working Hours: Standard business hours (with flexibility required during financial quarter-ends and audit periods)

Reporting Structure

  • Reports To: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) / Director of Finance
  • Direct Reports: Finance Managers, Senior Accountants, Financial Analysts

Success Metrics

  • 100% accuracy and timeliness in financial reporting and tax filings.
  • Successful optimization of working capital and improved cash flow cycles.
  • Zero non-compliance issues during internal and external financial audits.
  • Effective identification and execution of cost-saving initiatives resulting in increased overall profitability.
